newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Amoy to raise HK$3.39 bln in share issue.
newsitem.headline: Amoy to raise HK$3.39 bln in share issue.

text.p: Amoy Properties Ltd said it would place 310 million existing shares at HK$11.10 per share and issue 310 million new shares at the same price, raising net proceeds of about HK$3.39 billion.

Amoy said in a statement on Wednesday that Prosperland Housing Ltd had agreed to place the 310 million existing shares, or 12.4 percent of Amoy's existing issued share capital, to institutional or professional investors and then subscribe to the new shares. Prosperland is a unit of Amoy parent Hang Lung Development Co Ltd.
Net proceeds are expected to be used for property investment and general working capital.
